What is confirmed: (1) the entity exists and is active — irisglobal.in is a live corporate site describing a B2B ICT distribution business (laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, servers, storage, networking, security, UPS), 70+ brands, 10,000+ channel partners, 32 warehouse-cum-branch offices; (2) it operates as a PUBLIC limited company, not private — the site brands itself "Iris Global Services Limited", names a board (Sanjiv Krishen Chairman & MD, Kamini Talwar and Pankaj Dhingra Whole-Time Directors, three Independent Directors, CEO, CFO, Company Secretary) and hosts a Draft Red Herring Prospectus, annual returns, shareholding pattern and SEBI Reg. 46 disclosures, which only a public/unlisted-public entity files. The input's "IRIS GLOBAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED" is therefore most likely the former name of the same entity (name change on conversion), not a separate company — but this needs confirmation from MCA. What is NOT confirmed: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, exact date of incorporation, and MCA status — all null because Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck and InstaFinancials blocked automated access (HTTP 403) and the web_search backend was down (connection refused) throughout this session. Role assessed as trader: the company describes itself as a distributor/reseller of third-party technology brands with value-added logistics, credit support and warranty services — no own manufacturing is claimed, so manufacturer is not supported. HS codes 844331 (printers/copiers) and 847150 (processing units) are consistent with its declared printer and computing distribution lines, so no HS correction is indicated. Revenue FY25/FY26: null — the site hosts audited financials for FY 25-26 and FY 24-25 but the document links 404'd; figures must be pulled from those PDFs or MCA filings before use.
